title: Workspace-wide local gate uses the hermetic nextest runner too: the whole-workspace hermetic sweep is clean
goal: T-CLAUDECHARMINGCURIE-2 kept the workspace-wide local gate (a lockfile/toolchain/build.rs change, or SUSI_LOCAL_GATE=full) on plain cargo test, because a whole-workspace hermetic sweep had one failing test (susi-paths, fixed in T-NEXTESTBOUNDARY-1) and had never run its empty-SUSI_HOME assertion. The sweep now passes: SUSI_HERMETIC_RUNNER=nextest scripts/check-hermetic-tests.sh --workspace ran 3,675 tests (61.7 s of test time) plus the doc-tests, and SUSI_HOME stayed empty. So the ALL path takes the same single hermetic, per-test-retried run as the scoped one, and the AGENTS.md ratchet entry that said otherwise is removed.
